便签、纸页笔记、日历和画纸都从<b>底部应用坞</b>打开。再点一次已打开的图标: Sticky notes, pages, the calendar, and drawing sheets all open from the bottom dock. Click an open icon again and its window minimizes.
拖<b>标题栏</b>移动窗口，拖右下角缩放。没有缩小/放大/关闭按钮：点底部应: Drag the title bar to move a window and the bottom-right corner to resize. There is no shrink/enlarge/close button: tap a dock icon to minimize or restore, the house button tucks all windows away at once, and Esc closes the current window.
按住便签顶部左侧的<b>把手</b>再拖动；正文区域只负责输入，不会误拖。: Hold the handle at the top left of a sticky to drag it; the body area is only for typing, so you will not drag it by accident.
不想一个个关窗口？点最右边的<b>房子按钮</b>，或直接点窗口外的空白桌面，所: Do not want to close windows one by one? Click the house button on the far right, or click the empty desk outside the windows, and every window goes back into the dock. Click a dock icon to bring one back.
跟随 DSH 时用宿主界面语言；也可以固定中文或 English。改完会重新铺一: When set to follow DSH it uses the host's interface language; you can also pin Chinese or English. The desk is laid out again after the change.
